newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi says no plan to revise 97/98 capex.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi says no plan to revise 97/98 capex.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd said on Tuesday it had made no change in its planned group capital spending of 150 billion yen in fiscal 1997/98, denying a media report that it is mulling a boost in its investment programme.
"The 1997/98 budget already includes investments in our next-generation semiconductor plant and we have no plan to revise the programme," a Hitachi spokesman said.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Tuesday that Hitachi would spend 150 billion yen to build a new chip plant in Japan to begin mass production of next-generation chips in the second half of 1999.
The spokesman said Hitachi began construction of the new plant, which will use 300 mm diameter wafers, in 1996.
